def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    target_fraction = 0.3
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    target_capacities = target_fraction * bins
    closeness = -np.abs(remaining - target_capacities)
    scores[valid] = closeness[valid] + bins[valid] * 1e-10
    return scores

    Return:

    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priority_scores[valid] = -remaining[valid]

algorithm: {We prioritize bins where adding the item would make the remaining capacity closest to a multiple of the item size, favoring bins with smaller remaining capacity after placement in case of ties.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if np.any(valid):
        multiples = np.floor(remaining[valid] / item)
        target_capacities = multiples * item
        closeness = -np.abs(remaining[valid] - target_capacities)
        scores[valid] = closeness - remaining[valid] * 1e-10
    return scores
